title: A woman was arrested in Philly for blocking a delivery robot
script:
Police in Philadelphia arrested a woman for blocking a sidewalk delivery robot.
Carolyn Marvin stood directly in front of an Uber robot to halt it.
She refused to move when officers requested that she clear the sidewalk path.
Marvin told ABC13 she was protesting because AI takes jobs from human delivery workers.
Authorities officially charged Marvin with disorderly conduct for the obstruction.
Uber utilizes these automated sidewalk units to manage local food delivery orders.
Would you ever stand in the way of a robot?
